title: Team of AIs or just one? Anthropic says both

scenes.say: Anthropic's AI team beat a solo AI by ninety point two percent. Now Anthropic says one AI frequently wins.
scenes.headline: Team of AIs or just one?

scenes.say: Both are true. That win was on Anthropic's own research test.
scenes.label: Team vs solo AI, 2025

scenes.say: The one-AI win came from a different job: several company deployments, one AI grabbing tools as needed.
scenes.headline: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop

scenes.say: Often cheaper and faster. No figures, though.
Helpers still have their place, Anthropic says. When one AI is swamped. Or when jobs must run side by side.
scenes.title: Helpers still have their place
items: Jobs must run side by side

scenes.say: The catch: in Anthropic's sample support bot, after two helpers merged, it skipped checking the delivery date. One run in two.
scenes.title: Catch: sample bot
scenes.text: Skipped the delivery date in 1 of 2 runs

scenes.say: Anthropic's advice back in January: start simple, add more only with evidence. Team of AIs, or just one?
scenes.sub: Anthropic, Jan 2026: start simple, add only with evidence
